text: USGS PAGER alert: M7.8 earthquake 26km east of Nurdağı, Gaziantep province, Turkey; depth 17.9km; RED alert for shaking-related casualties
AFAD: Kahramanmaraş Pazarcık merkezli 7.4 büyüklüğünde deprem kaydedildi (AFAD records M7.4 quake centered in Pazarcık, Kahramanmaras)
Gaziantep'te çok sayıda bina yıkıldı, enkaz altında kalanlar var (many buildings collapsed in Gaziantep, people trapped under rubble)
Unverified videos show collapsed apartment blocks in Malatya and Diyarbakır; phone networks congested across SE Turkey
Reuters: Powerful M7.8 earthquake hits southeast Turkey and northern Syria; hundreds reported dead, toll climbing
AFAD: over 900 confirmed dead across 10 provinces, thousands of buildings reported collapsed; national emergency declared
White Helmets: dozens of buildings flattened in Aleppo and Idlib countryside; rescue teams overwhelmed, heavy equipment needed
Turkcell reports significant mobile network outages across quake zone; backup power and mobile base stations being deployed
USGS: M7.5 earthquake near Ekinözü, Kahramanmaras — major aftershock ~95km north of the first rupture, further collapses reported
AP: Second major quake compounds devastation; rescuers dig through night in freezing rain, toll passes 1,500 across Turkey and Syria
Port of Iskenderun reports structural damage to quay and container yard; crane operations halted pending inspection
AIS: at least 8 cargo vessels holding or diverting off Iskenderun; tugs recalled to harbor, inbound pilots suspended
İskenderun limanında devrilen konteynerler arasında yangın çıktı (fire broke out among toppled containers at Iskenderun port)
LimakPort: operations at Iskenderun container terminal suspended; container stacks toppled, fire reported in yard, damage assessment underway
Transport ministry: Hatay Airport runway fractured, airport closed; all southeastern ports ordered to conduct structural inspections
Reuters: Hundreds of shipping containers toppled and ablaze at Iskenderun port; operations suspended as crews battle the fire
Liman yangını gece boyunca büyüdü, duman şehir üzerinde (the port fire grew overnight, smoke over the city)
Rotterdam reports normal vessel turnaround times; Europe-Asia schedules unaffected
Ceyhan marine terminal suspends crude loadings; BTC pipeline and tanks undergoing post-quake integrity inspection
Brent crude edges higher as Ceyhan halt removes ~1M bbl/day of Azeri and Iraqi export capacity; terminal carries ~1% of global supply
Erdogan declares 3-month state of emergency in 10 provinces; confirmed toll passes 3,500 in Turkey, 1,000+ in Syria
OCHA: Bab al-Hawa cross-border aid route into NW Syria disrupted by road damage; humanitarian corridor urgently needed
Drone footage shows Iskenderun container yard flattened — hundreds of boxes collapsed in rows, fire still burning among the stacks
AP: Shipping lines begin diverting Iskenderun-bound cargo to Mersin and Mersin-adjacent terminals as port fire enters second day
Maersk suspends all new bookings to Iskenderun; cargo to be redirected via Mersin and eastern Med transshipment hubs
Forwarders quote congestion surcharges for Turkey Med routings; reefer and steel cargo stranded in Iskenderun yard
Kpler: two Aframax loadings deferred at Ceyhan anchorage; tankers waiting offshore, no ETA for terminal reopening
Anadolu: Combined Turkey-Syria death toll surpasses 5,000; AFAD reports ~5,800 buildings destroyed, rescue crews from 14 countries arriving
Port of LA reports dwell times steady; no abnormal congestion
Reuters: Death toll exceeds 7,800 and rising; rescue window narrowing in sub-zero temperatures, hopes fading for survivors
DHMI: Gaziantep airport reserved for rescue and military flights; Hatay airport remains closed after runway split, repairs underway
IFRC launches emergency appeal; winter storm and damaged roads slowing aid delivery into the hardest-hit provinces
مشاهد من حلب: مبانٍ منهارة وعائلات عالقة تحت الأنقاض (scenes from Aleppo: collapsed buildings and families trapped under rubble)
Bloomberg: Iskenderun outage disrupts Turkish steel exports — the port handles a large share of rebar and scrap flows; buyers seek alternatives
Hapag-Lloyd declares force majeure on Iskenderun calls; port infrastructure severely damaged, no ETA for resumption
Damascus-based assessment: earthquake toll in Syria approaching 2,500; Aleppo, Latakia and Idlib governorates worst affected
Marine cargo insurers flag large claims at Iskenderun; container yard damage estimated in the hundreds of millions
TSMC Hsinchu operations normal; no seismic activity reported at fab sites
Reuters: Iskenderun port fire finally brought under control on day four; container terminal devastated, hundreds of boxes destroyed
AFAD: confirmed deaths in Turkey pass 17,600 with tens of thousands injured; combined toll with Syria above 21,000
BOTAS: BTC pipeline inspections complete, no damage found; Ceyhan terminal preparing to restart crude loadings
Cyprus geological survey notes continued aftershock sequence along East Anatolian fault; tremors felt across the island
Turkish rebar and flat-steel export offers withdrawn; scrap import bookings for Iskenderun region mills on hold
Iskenderun port authority: terminal closed indefinitely; quay cranes and yard systems require full structural assessment
AP: Erdogan tours disaster zone, acknowledges early response shortfalls; promises rapid reconstruction of collapsed towns
Panama Canal draft restrictions unchanged this week; transits normal
Reuters: Ceyhan oil terminal resumes crude loadings after quake inspections; BTC pipeline fully operational
Trade ministry: export clearance redirected to Mersin and other Med ports while Iskenderun undergoes reconstruction
TankerTrackers: first post-quake Aframax loading under way at Ceyhan; backlog of deferred cargoes clearing
First UN aid convoy crosses Bab al-Hawa into NW Syria since the quake; OCHA presses for additional border crossings
Container spot rates on Turkey-Med lanes stabilize as diversions to Mersin absorb Iskenderun volumes; war-risk premiums for the zone reviewed
Shanghai container throughput normal; no weather or congestion advisories
Reuters: Combined death toll tops 28,000; UN warns final figure could more than double as rubble clearance continues
LimakPort: rebuilding of Iskenderun terminal expected to take months; limited berths may reopen first for relief vessels
WFP scaling food corridors into the quake zone; damaged roads and border bottlenecks remain the main logistics constraint
Reuters: Combined toll exceeds 33,000 a week after the quake; rescue operations transitioning to recovery in hardest-hit towns
AFAD weekly assessment: 29,600+ confirmed dead in Turkey, over 80,000 injured; aftershock activity continuing
Iskenderun partially reopens one berth for humanitarian and relief cargo only; commercial container ops still suspended
Bloomberg: Ceyhan fully back online — Azeri BTC and Iraqi Kirkuk crude loadings normalized, deferred cargoes cleared
Lloyd's market estimates Turkey quake insured losses in the billions; port and cargo claims at Iskenderun among largest non-life exposures
OCHA: humanitarian response scaling up; logistics hubs established at Mersin and Gaziantep, Iskenderun corridor partially usable
